cd /workspace && sleep 30; curl -sS -m 15 http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null > /tmp/procs.json; ~/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.13 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/procs.json'))['data']
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(p['status'] for p in d)
print('STATUS COUNTS:', dict(c))
print()
for p in sorted(d,key=lambda x:x['name']):
    st=p.get('status')
    if st not in ('Running',):
        print(f\"{p['name']:45} {st:14} exit={p.get('exit_code')} restarts={p.get('restarts')}\")
print()
print('Total processes:', len(d))
